dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: The books here aren't too complicated. Even I'm having an easy time reading them...!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: When I get back, I need to thank Master Tighnari for his literacy classes.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: I'm more determined than ever now to stick with it, so that one day, I'll be able to read even more complicated books.
